code.text: Localized delivery of chlorhexidine at affected periodontal sites

note.text: Localized chlorhexidine chip placed at the affected periodontal sites to reduce bacterial load (the drug administration itself is recorded as MedicationAdministration/medicationadministration-chlorhexidine). COVERAGE-UNCERTAIN: whether D4381 is covered under the HUSKY B pediatric benefit is a genuinely open question in the source material — carried here as performed clinical care and flagged as coverage-uncertain on the Interaction 5 claims-sharing EOB, not asserted as covered.
